entities.name: Mangara of Corondor
entities.description: Centuries-old peaceful human mage and diplomat on Dominaria, protected by Eskil the White; ruled Zhalfir and was imprisoned in the Amber Prison.

entities.name: Eskil the White
entities.description: Planeswalker who protected and reputedly taught Mangara.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Mage who sought domination of Jamuraa and trapped Mangara; later trapped in the prison.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: Mage manipulated by Kaervek into fighting Mangara.

entities.name: Asmira
entities.description: Freed Mangara from the Amber with Rashida Scalebane.

entities.name: Rashida Scalebane
entities.description: Freed Mangara from the Amber with Asmira.

entities.name: Mundungu
entities.description: Of the tomb-city of Aku; aided Mangara.

entities.name: Amber Prison
entities.description: Prison that trapped Mangara and later Kaervek.

entities.name: Mangara's Harmony
entities.description: New age of equity under Mangara.

events.summary: Mangara researches Teferi's Isle and joins Kaervek and Jolrael.
events.quote: he joined the two other mages that had been attracted by the event

events.summary: Mangara's diplomacy resolves tensions among Zhalfir, Femeref and Suq'Ata and he gains control of all three, bringing Mangara's Harmony.
events.quote: Mangara brought about a new age of equity, known as Mangara's Harmony

events.summary: Kaervek twists Mangara's peacemaking into signs of an army, ensnaring Jolrael.
Kaervek and Jolrael trap Mangara in the Amber Prison.
events.quote: ultimately trapped him in the Amber Prison

events.summary: Asmira and Rashida free Mangara, who with Quirion and Mundungu allies traps Kaervek in the Prison.
events.quote: Mangara was able to turn the tide and trap Kaervek in the Prison

events.summary: Mangara is brought to post-apocalyptic Dominaria through the time rifts.
events.quote: Mangara was one of the individuals brought to post-apocalyptic Dominaria through the time rifts

relations.quote: he developed close a close alliance with the Quirion elves
he was rumored to become a pupil of the planeswalker Eskil
Kaervek immediately recognized the danger that Mangara represented
The two great mages took up arms against Mangara
Ruling Zhalfir with an honest, pure hand
